verdict.rationale: Google Drive documents a REST v3 API with three upload types (simple, multipart, resumable) and a files.list method, and its OAuth scope text covers creating and deleting files. Download and move operations are not explicitly documented in the pack. Third-party tools like rclone pulling all content out of Drive indirectly corroborate programmatic retrieval. Missing for 10: explicit download (files.get/alt=media) endpoint docs, documented move (parent change) operation, dedicated delete endpoint reference beyond scope wording, independent hands-on API corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, files move through a real API — upload, download, list, move, and delete over documented REST endpoints, not just a desktop client

citations.quote: The Google Drive API allows clients to access resources from Google Drive.
Simple upload (`uploadType=media`): Use this upload type to transfer a small media file (5 MB or less) without supplying metadata.
Resumable upload (`uploadType=resumable`): Use this upload type for large files (greater than 5 MB)
You can use the list method on the files resource to return all or some of a Drive user's files and folders.
See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app
rclone is a great cli tool that can let you easily pull all content out of a Google drive
